'''Sketto Leap''' was part of the [[Malastare 100/Legends|Malastare 100]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. The section was notoriously difficult, involving a long jump off a ramp, above a deep chasm. The name of the section came from a large [[Sketto/Legends|Sketto]] hovering above the chasm.
